+import re
+
+
+def slugify(text: str) -> str:
+    """
+    Convert text to a URL-friendly slug.
+    
+    - Lowercases the text
+    - Replaces every run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen
+    - Strips hyphens from both ends
+    
+    Example:
+        >>> slugify('  Hello, World!! ')
+        'hello-world'
+    """
+    # Lowercase the text
+    text = text.lower()
+    
+    # Replace every run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen
+    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
+    
+    # Strip hyphens from both ends
+    text = text.strip('-')
+    
+    return text

@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+def slugify(text):
+    """Return a slug version of the text.
+    
+    Converts text to lowercase, replaces non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens,
+    and strips leading/trailing hyphens.
+    """
+    if not text:
+        return ''
+    
+    # Lowercase the text
+    text = text.lower()
+    
+    # Replace runs of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen
+    import re
+    slug = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
+    
+    # Strip hyphens from both ends
+    slug = slug.strip('-')
+    
+    return slug
